name: Knight of Xoroth: a Shieldgore button survives relog (COA-5817)
contract: Shieldgore (301302) replaces Infernal Strike (801016) with the Shieldgore rank for the level. A button holding
Shieldgore is saved as Infernal Strike. On login, AscensionClassService synchronized the replacement, which sent
SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL (300) 801016 -> 806870, and then reloaded the action bars asynchronously, which sent
SMSG_ACTION_BUTTONS with Infernal Strike after the swap. The client no longer had Infernal Strike in its
spellbook, so the button came back empty. Every active replacement is now announced again right after that
reload, so the client swaps the reloaded button. The server's own bar keeps the original, as

steps.label: SETUP: Infernal Strike shows as Shieldgore Rank 3
The Shieldgore button is saved as Infernal Strike
The server bar holds Infernal Strike, the spell the replacement stands in for
Shieldgore stands in for Infernal Strike again
DISCRIMINATING: the swap is announced again after the reloaded bars reach the client
